cohort: The participants were Sprague-Dawley pregnant rats divided into a control group and two groups exposed to different doses of Topiramate.
finding: Maternal exposure to therapeutic doses of Topiramate led to a significant decrease in umbilical cord length, placental weight, and highly significant reduction in fetal growth parameters, indicating symmetrical fetal gross restriction.
gest_age: Fetuses were observed at day 20 of gestation.
